technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (MACD, RSI-9, Supertrend) show early bullish crossovers, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, limiting conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CPRT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 82 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional sales by junior member and lack of news confirmation provide minimal conviction support.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 82 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum crossovers (MACD, RSI-9, Supertrend) combined with extreme fear sentiment (22/100) and price near support (29.36) create a contrarian entry opportunity for tactical swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains structurally below all key moving averages (EMA-21, SMA-21) and Ichimoku cloud, VIX crisis regime (367.2) dominates macro risk, zero fundamental catalysts exist, and earnings event risk in 82 days negates any short-term momentum advantage.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum crossovers (MACD, RSI-9, Supertrend) offer tactical appeal at support, but structural weakness below all key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud severely limits swing trade probability.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (367.2) and macro unfavourable environment override short-term technicals; earnings event in 82 days adds uncompensated event risk to a fundamentally weak setup.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals show early bullish signals but are overwhelmed by macro risk, fundamental weakness, and structural price positioning below key levels.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 10 positions in Industrials sector; adding CPRT increases concentration risk without conviction catalyst or institutional support.
